gate.where: an SDK plugin folder ~/.cline/plugins/derm/ (or $CLINE_DIR/plugins/derm/), beforeTool; and the approval-file responder derm run cline starts beside it (CLINE_TOOL_APPROVAL_MODE=desktop, CLINE_TOOL_APPROVAL_DIR)

coverage.note: the plugin runs before Cline's own policy in every mode: deny skips the call, ask forces Cline's approval ({autoApprove: false}) even under --auto-approve true, which Orca passes (run); a throw or a 3 s timeout runs the call under Cline's own policy (fails open, no switch in the CLI). In 3.0.74 the approval files never reach a responder in a prompt run (run: the hub denies non-interactive approvals, the local backend has no session id yet), so an ask in a headless run is a deny; in the TUI it is Cline's own prompt.
